pages.title: Wearable Charms
pages.text: A talisman paper has no effect while it is ordinary paper. Right-click it to fold it, then place the folded talisman in a charm slot to activate its power.

Folded talismans keep their type and remaining uses, shown by their durability bar. A fully charged talisman can be right-clicked to unfold it back into paper. Each kind activates under its own condition, and each activation consumes a use and has a short cooldown.
